method: Five balanced pairs, warm local filesystem, loopback isolated OpenSSH with explicit generated Ed25519 identity, pinned strict known_hosts, no agent, fixed curve25519-sha256 / ssh-ed25519 / aes128-ctr / hmac-sha2-256, no compression; ready includes auth and SFTP v3 initialization; 500ms idle; list 512 UTF-8 filenames, then 16MiB generated binary upload to exclusive temporary file, fstat, fsync, close ACK, v3 no-clobber rename; download byte comparison plus before/after fstat, EOF, close; remove explicit test target. Real congminal Rust codec/client/model/transfer vs ssh2 0.9.6 Rust wrapper of libssh2 SFTP API. Standalone prototypes, not full UI integration. Wrapper directory retains bounded paths and FileStat, own adapter also retains escaped labels; directory work differs. Both transfer byte generation and validation use Rust. Parent/ssh client RSS sums may double-count shared mappings; server sampled separately. Cancellation/weak network/30min not benchmarked here.
sampler: libproc 每 5 ms；Mach 时间基准 125/3；进程树最多 64 项
